subject: Mythology
title: Anubis: Guardian of the Dead
description: A short lesson to help you apply Anubis: Guardian of the Dead.

hook.text: Anubis had the head of a jackal and guided every dead soul through the dangerous journey to the afterlife.

buildup.text: He invented mummification, preserving Osiris's body as the very first mummy in all of Egyptian myth.

discovery.text: At the Hall of Truth, Anubis weighed each person's heart against the feather of Ma'at to judge their soul.

twist.text: If the heart was heavier than the feather, a monster called Ammit devoured it, erasing that soul forever.

climax.text: Egyptians spent their entire lives trying to keep their hearts light enough to pass his final test.

punchline.text: Your entire afterlife depended on the weight of your heart.

quiz.question: What did Anubis weigh against the feather of Ma'at?
